title: Front End Live Design Tool
content:
## Front End Live Design Tool


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000039736

This tool allows to make colors changes on the front-end of the site, based on some of the color settings available in the Design Settings. ! With this new tool make design changes and see them right away! This will prevent from going back and forth between the admin page and the front end of the website.

To use this tool please go to Settings >> Design Settings >> General >> Live Design Tool +

Clicking on this will open the homepage right away with this new sidebar tool!

Do know that this tool does not have all the options that are available in the Design Settings, please be sure to still use the admin tool to make additional changes that aren't on this tool.

For more details on these settings check out this article: Design Settings
